description: The plot titled “Whisper fine-tunning, type = tiny” illustrates how WER changes over training epochs for five tiny-model configurations. The x-axis is labeled “epoch,” uses a linear scale, and runs from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks at every 1 epoch. The y-axis is labeled “WER,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from the low 20s up to about 70, with major ticks shown at 30, 40, 50, 60, and 70. A solid line with circle markers (“tiny AdaLoRA_int4”) decreases from about 69 at epoch 0 to about 60 (epoch 1), ~55 (epoch 2), ~45 (epoch 3), ~40 (epoch 4), ~37 (epoch 5), and ~36 (epoch 6). A solid line with square markers (“tiny AdaLoRA_int8”) decreases from about 60 at epoch 0 to ~51 (epoch 1), ~51 (epoch 2), ~44 (epoch 3), ~38 (epoch 4), ~35 (epoch 5), and ~32 (epoch 6). A dashed line with circle markers (“tiny int4”) decreases from about 69 at epoch 0 to ~55 (epoch 1), ~50 (epoch 2), ~44 (epoch 3), ~39 (epoch 4), then is near ~39 at epoch 5 and ~40 at epoch 6. A dashed line with square markers (“tiny int8”) decreases from about 59 at epoch 0 to ~47 (epoch 1), ~46 (epoch 2), ~43 (epoch 3), ~38 (epoch 4), ~37 (epoch 5), and ~37 (epoch 6). A dotted line with triangle markers (“tiny full”) decreases from about 29 at epoch 0 to ~27 (epoch 1), ~27 (epoch 2), ~24 (epoch 3), ~24 (epoch 4), ~23.5 (epoch 5), and ~23 (epoch 6).
